fields.effect_text:

fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in radius may retrieve a discarded card. If they do, each enemy hero in radius loses 1 coin.

fields.name: Broomstick Beatdown

fields.name: Collateral Misfortune
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a unit in range adjacent to an enemy hero.

fields.name: Fungal Favor

fields.name: Candy Trail

fields.name: Trouble Brewing

fields.name: Tidal Blast
